findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: show_cat_photos, search_public_content, get_public_post, get_cat_profile, list_cat_breeds · Private data: check_cat_food_safety · Public sink: show_cat_photos, get_public_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: show_cat_photos, search_public_content, get_public_post, get_cat_profile, list_cat_breeds · Private data: check_cat_food_safety · Public sink: show_cat_photos, get_public_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_cat_age" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
